question: In an office, the number of male employees is (3)/(8) of the number of female employees. (1)/(3) of the males are non-graduates, whereas (4)/(9) of the females are non-graduates. If the number of non-graduate employees in the office is 164, then the total number of employees in the office is:
solution:
Given:

In an office, the number of male employees is (3)/(8) of the number of female employees.

 (1)/(3) of the males are non-graduates, whereas (4)/(9) of the females are non-graduates. 

The number of non-graduate employees in the office is 164.

Calculation:

Hence, the ratio of male employees to female employees = 3 : 8

Let the common ratio be Q.

Now, the number of male and female employees are 3Q and 8Q.

Thus,

The number of male non-graduates = 3Q × 1/3 = Q

The number of female non-graduates = 8Q × 4/9 = 32Q/9

According to the question,

Q + 32Q/9 = 164

⇒ 41Q/9 = 164

⇒ Q = 164 × 9/41

⇒ Q = 36

Now, the number of total employees

⇒ 3Q + 8Q

⇒ 11Q

⇒ 11 × 36

⇒ 396

**∴ The total number of employees in the office is 396.**
